title: Credential Grant
description: Metadata describing a stored credential: which provider, which method produced it, when it expires, whether it can refresh. The secret values live in the user-global credential store at mode 0600 and are referenced, never embedded — this record is what may be shown, logged, or returned by keryx auth status.

expiresAt.description: Absent for credentials that do not expire, such as a plain API key.

refreshable.description: Whether the grant carries a refresh token. A refresh failure surfaces as an authorization error, never a silent downgrade.

fingerprint.description: Non-reversible identifier used to tell two credentials apart in logs. Never the value, and never a prefix of it.
